_comment: The menu itself is built from the live tmux key bindings (tmux list-keys),
so this file only fills in what tmux cannot tell us.
_descriptions: Text shown next to a key. Overrides the bind-key -N note, and gives a description to bindings that have none (they fall back to the raw command).
_groups: Move a key into another group. Valid values: window, pane, session, layout, buffer, misc.
_hide: Keys to leave out of the menu entirely.
